13
Ɔsom a ɛsɔ Nyankopɔn ani
1 # Yoh 13.34; 2 Pe 1.7 Onuadɔ ntena hɔ daa. 2#Rom 12.13; 1 Pe 4.9; Gye 18.3; 19.2-3 Ahɔhoyɛ nso, mommma mo ani mmpa so; ɛfiri sɛ yei so na ebinom nam yɛɛ abɔfoɔ hɔhoɔ a wɔn ani nni soɔ. 3#Mat 25.36 Monkae nneduafoɔ, sɛdeɛ mo ne wɔn na ɛda afiase, ne wɔn a wɔhunu amane biara, sɛ mo ara nso moda so wɔ honam mu yi. 4#Gal 5.19; 5.21; Efe 5.5 Wɔnni awadeɛ ni, ade nyinaa mu, na wɔnngu awadeɛ mpa ho fi; ɛfiri sɛ nnwamamfoɔ ne awaresɛefoɔ deɛ, Onyankopɔn bɛbu wɔn atɛn.
5 # 1 Ti 6.6; Yos 1.5 Mommma sikanibereɛ mmma mo abrabɔ mu, na mo ani nsɔ deɛ mowɔ no; ɛfiri sɛ ɔno ara aka sɛ: Merennya wo, nanso merempa wo da. 6#Dwom 118.6 Na ɛma yɛde nnamyɛ ka sɛ:
Awurade ne me boafoɔ,
merensuro.
Onipa bɛtumi ayɛ me deɛn?
7 # Heb 13.17; 1 Ko 4.16 Monkae mo mpanimfoɔ a wɔaka Nyankopɔn asɛm akyerɛ mo. Monhwɛ wɔn abrabɔ awieeɛ nsua wɔn gyidie. 8#1 Ko 3.11; Adi 1.17 Yesu Kristo te sɛdeɛ ɔteɛ nnora, ɛnnɛ, ɛne daapem nyinaa. 9#Efe 4.14; 2 Ko 1.21; Rom 14.17 Mommma nkyerɛkyerɛ ahodoɔ ne nsɛm foforɔ mmfa mo nnkyinkyini, na ɛyɛ sɛ wɔde adom hyɛ akoma den, na ɛnyɛ nnuane a wɔn a wɔdiiɛ no nni ho mfasoɔ biara. 10#Heb 8.4-5 Yɛwɔ afɔrebukyia a wɔn a wɔsom ntomadan no nni ho kwan sɛ wɔdi ho biribie. 11#Lew 16.27 Na mmoa a bɔne nti ɔsɔfo panin de wɔn mogya kɔ kronkron mu no, wɔhye wɔn afunu nsra no akyiri. 12#Mat 21.39; Yoh 9.22 Na Yesu nso, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na ɔde ɔno ara ne mogya ate ɔman no ho nti, ɔhunuu amane, kuro no pono akyi. 13#Heb 11.26; 12.2 Ɛno nti momma yɛmfiri adi nkɔ ne nkyɛn nsraban no akyiri nkɔsoa n’ahohora. 14#Heb 11.10; 12.22 Na yɛnni kuro a ɛwɔ hɔ daa wɔ ha, na mmom deɛ ɛbɛba no akyiri kwan na yɛhwehwɛ.
15 # Dwom 50.14; 50.23; Hos 14.2 Enti momma yɛmfa ne so mmɔ Nyankopɔn ayeyie afɔdeɛ daa, ɛne anofafa a ɛbɔ no abodin no. 16#Flp 4.18 Na yieyɛ ne adekyɛ na mommma mo ani mmpa soɔ, ɛfiri sɛ saa afɔrebɔ no sɔ Nyankopɔn ani.
17 # 1 Te 5.12; Hes 3.18 Montie mo mpanimfoɔ na mommrɛ mo ho ase mma wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na wɔwɛn mo kra sɛ wɔn a wɔbɛbu ho akonta, na wɔde anigyeɛ ayɛ, na ɛnyɛ ahomeguo; ɛfiri sɛ yei nyɛ mfasoɔ biara mma mo.
18 # 2 Ko 1.12 Mommɔ mpaeɛ mma yɛn; ɛfiri sɛ yɛnim pefee sɛ yɛwɔ ahonim pa, pɛ sɛ yɛbɔ yɛn bra yie nnoɔma nyinaa mu. 19Na mesrɛ mo ara yie sɛ monyɛ yei, na wɔagyae me ama mo ntɛm pa.
Nhyira
20 # Yoh 10.11; 1 Pe 2.25 Na asomdwoeɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔnam daa apam no mogya soɔ, ayi nnwan no hwɛfoɔ kɛseɛ a ɔne yɛn Awurade Yesu afiri awufoɔ mu no, 21ɔnsiesie mo adepa biara mu mma monyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ, na ɔmfa Yesu Kristo so nyɛ mo mu ade a ɛsɔ n’ani. Ɔno na animuonyam nka no daa daa. Amen.
Afotuo ne nkyea a ɛdi akyire
22Anuanom, mesrɛ mo sɛ, montie afotusɛm yi; ɛfiri sɛ matwerɛ no nsɛm tiaa bi mamane mo. 23Monhunu sɛ wɔagyaa yɛn nua Timoteo; na sɛ ɔba ntɛm pa a, me ne no bɛba abɛhu mo. 24Monkyea mo mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ne ahotefoɔ nyinaa. Wɔn a wɔfiri Italia kyea mo. 25Adom nka mo nyinaa. [Amen.] #13.25 Tete atwerɛfoɔ a wɔgye wɔn to mu binom mfa yei nka ho.

pageProps.chapterText:
Onuadɔ ntena hɔ daa. Ahɔhoyɛ nso, mommma mo ani mmpa so; ɛfiri sɛ yei so na ebinom nam yɛɛ abɔfoɔ hɔhoɔ a wɔn ani nni soɔ. Monkae nneduafoɔ, sɛdeɛ mo ne wɔn na ɛda afiase, ne wɔn a wɔhunu amane biara, sɛ mo ara nso moda so wɔ honam mu yi. Wɔnni awadeɛ ni, ade nyinaa mu, na wɔnngu awadeɛ mpa ho fi; ɛfiri sɛ nnwamamfoɔ ne awaresɛefoɔ deɛ, Onyankopɔn bɛbu wɔn atɛn.
Mommma sikanibereɛ mmma mo abrabɔ mu, na mo ani nsɔ deɛ mowɔ no; ɛfiri sɛ ɔno ara aka sɛ: Merennya wo, nanso merempa wo da. Na ɛma yɛde nnamyɛ ka sɛ:
Awurade ne me boafoɔ,
merensuro.
Onipa bɛtumi ayɛ me deɛn?
Monkae mo mpanimfoɔ a wɔaka Nyankopɔn asɛm akyerɛ mo. Monhwɛ wɔn abrabɔ awieeɛ nsua wɔn gyidie. Yesu Kristo te sɛdeɛ ɔteɛ nnora, ɛnnɛ, ɛne daapem nyinaa. Mommma nkyerɛkyerɛ ahodoɔ ne nsɛm foforɔ mmfa mo nnkyinkyini, na ɛyɛ sɛ wɔde adom hyɛ akoma den, na ɛnyɛ nnuane a wɔn a wɔdiiɛ no nni ho mfasoɔ biara. Yɛwɔ afɔrebukyia a wɔn a wɔsom ntomadan no nni ho kwan sɛ wɔdi ho biribie. Na mmoa a bɔne nti ɔsɔfo panin de wɔn mogya kɔ kronkron mu no, wɔhye wɔn afunu nsra no akyiri. Na Yesu nso, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na ɔde ɔno ara ne mogya ate ɔman no ho nti, ɔhunuu amane, kuro no pono akyi. Ɛno nti momma yɛmfiri adi nkɔ ne nkyɛn nsraban no akyiri nkɔsoa n’ahohora. Na yɛnni kuro a ɛwɔ hɔ daa wɔ ha, na mmom deɛ ɛbɛba no akyiri kwan na yɛhwehwɛ.
Enti momma yɛmfa ne so mmɔ Nyankopɔn ayeyie afɔdeɛ daa, ɛne anofafa a ɛbɔ no abodin no. Na yieyɛ ne adekyɛ na mommma mo ani mmpa soɔ, ɛfiri sɛ saa afɔrebɔ no sɔ Nyankopɔn ani.
Montie mo mpanimfoɔ na mommrɛ mo ho ase mma wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na wɔwɛn mo kra sɛ wɔn a wɔbɛbu ho akonta, na wɔde anigyeɛ ayɛ, na ɛnyɛ ahomeguo; ɛfiri sɛ yei nyɛ mfasoɔ biara mma mo.
Mommɔ mpaeɛ mma yɛn; ɛfiri sɛ yɛnim pefee sɛ yɛwɔ ahonim pa, pɛ sɛ yɛbɔ yɛn bra yie nnoɔma nyinaa mu. Na mesrɛ mo ara yie sɛ monyɛ yei, na wɔagyae me ama mo ntɛm pa.

Na asomdwoeɛ Nyankopɔn a ɔnam daa apam no mogya soɔ, ayi nnwan no hwɛfoɔ kɛseɛ a ɔne yɛn Awurade Yesu afiri awufoɔ mu no, ɔnsiesie mo adepa biara mu mma monyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ, na ɔmfa Yesu Kristo so nyɛ mo mu ade a ɛsɔ n’ani. Ɔno na animuonyam nka no daa daa. Amen.

Anuanom, mesrɛ mo sɛ, montie afotusɛm yi; ɛfiri sɛ matwerɛ no nsɛm tiaa bi mamane mo. Monhunu sɛ wɔagyaa yɛn nua Timoteo; na sɛ ɔba ntɛm pa a, me ne no bɛba abɛhu mo. Monkyea mo mpanimfoɔ nyinaa ne ahotefoɔ nyinaa. Wɔn a wɔfiri Italia kyea mo. Adom nka mo nyinaa. [Amen.]

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
